verdict.rationale: Synthesia's own docs show you can create a custom avatar of a real person, either of yourself from a single photo or as a personal or branded avatar, which covers the avatar-creation half of the story. The evidence does not document any consent or verification flow for avatars. The consent and safety controls mentioned apply only to voice cloning, a different capability, so they earn no credit here. The community comment about avatar realism is not about consent and was ignored. Missing for 10: a documented consent capture and identity verification flow for custom avatars, details of the avatar creation workflow for a third-party real person, and independent corroboration.
